About Harrowgate Press

Harrowgate Press is an independent publisher of regional history and landscape writing, founded in Skipton in 2011 by Eileen Trask.

Contact the editors

The list

As of 2021 the backlist runs to 38 titles across three series. We add four new titles a year.

The team

Two editors, one designer and one part-time publicist work from the Otley Street office. Distribution is handled by a partner warehouse in Leeds.
